Ubuntu Home Lab ServerComplete Setup Guide

Production-ready home server with Node.js, NestJS, Docker, PostgreSQL, NVIDIA GPU, and more

Get Started
View on GitHub

🐧 Linux Fundamentals

Master Ubuntu Server from installation to advanced configuration. Learn partitioning, filesystems, users, permissions, and SSH.

🔒 Security First

Harden your server with UFW firewall, Fail2ban, SSH hardening, AppArmor, auditd, and file integrity monitoring.

🐳 Modern Stack

Deploy with Docker Compose, Nginx reverse proxy, SSL certificates, PM2 process management, and PostgreSQL.

🤖 AI Ready

Set up NVIDIA GPU with CUDA, Ollama for local LLMs, and Python environment for AI/ML workloads.

📊 Observability

Monitor with htop, journalctl, custom health checks, disk alerts, and log rotation.

🛠️ Dev Experience

Tmux sessions, Git hooks for auto-deploy, environment management, and comprehensive troubleshooting.
